disputes.reason: Two claims in one (hard to interpret AND no clear link to target rating); the bank's own sources conflicted (earlier key said ES has no glaring weaknesses), and a candidate can argue ES at a stated confidence level does map to a target rating.

Not self-contained: 'of the uses of an economic capital framework ... meant more for protecting against risk deterioration' is a relative ranking against other uses not shown; stress testing, limits etc. could equally be argued as protective.
